# Exact MPL-covered decoder source

These are unmodified crates.io source archives for Symphonia 0.5.5 and the MP3,
core and metadata packages resolved by Cargo.lock. They are retained to make the
covered source available with the public project and binary source packages.
Each `.crate` is a gzip-compressed tar archive; extract with `tar -xzf FILE.crate`.
The MPL 2.0 text is included. Original copyright and source headers are retained.

Source: https://github.com/pdeljanov/Symphonia and
https://crates.io/crates/symphonia/0.5.5 (likewise for each exact package name).
Checksums are the matching package checksums in the root Cargo.lock.

When distributing an APK, include these source archives in its accompanying
source distribution and keep a working source link in the distributed notices.
They do not relicense the rest of this project under MPL or replace notices for
other dependencies. The app's bundled Rust-dependencies.txt points to the exact
upstream package sources. Changes to these packages would need corresponding
covered source updates.
